oneLiner: 连接微观粒子与宏观质量的桥梁，1 mol 含约 6.02×10²³ 个粒子。
oneLinerEn: Bridges particles and mass; 1 mol holds about 6.02×10²³ entities.
detail: n = m/M = N/Nₐ = V/Vm（气体标况 22.4 L/mol）；是化学计算的核心枢纽。
detailEn: n = m/M = N/Nₐ = V/Vm (22.4 L/mol for gases at STP); the hub of stoichiometry.

oneLiner: 单位体积溶液里所含溶质的物质的量，单位 mol/L。
oneLinerEn: Moles of solute per litre of solution, in mol/L.
detail: c = n/V；配制一定物质的量浓度溶液需用容量瓶、定容到刻度线。
detailEn: c = n/V; prepared in a volumetric flask, made up to the mark.

oneLiner: 加水稀释前后溶质的量不变，据此计算浓度。
oneLinerEn: Solute amount stays constant when diluting; the basis of c₁V₁ = c₂V₂.
detail: 稀释定律 c₁V₁ = c₂V₂；配制稀溶液时按此量取浓溶液与水的体积。
detailEn: Dilution law c₁V₁ = c₂V₂; measure the concentrated solution and water accordingly.

oneLiner: 一定温度下某固体在 100 g 溶剂里达到饱和所溶解的质量。
oneLinerEn: Grams of solute that saturate 100 g of solvent at a given temperature.
detail: 溶解度曲线随温度变化：多数固体升高、气体与少数物质（如熟石灰）降低；可分离提纯（蒸发结晶、降温结晶）。
detailEn: Solubility curves: most solids rise with temperature, gases and a few (e.g. slaked lime) fall; used for separation by evaporation or cooling crystallization.

oneLiner: 在水溶液或熔融态能导电的化合物为电解质，反之非电解质。
oneLinerEn: Compounds conducting in solution or melt are electrolytes; others are non-electrolytes.
detail: 强电解质（强酸、强碱、大部分盐）完全电离，弱电解质（弱酸弱碱）部分电离；电离方程式用 = 或 ⇌ 表示。
detailEn: Strong electrolytes ionize fully (shown with =), weak ones partially (⇌).

oneLiner: 衡量溶液酸碱性强弱的标度，pH = −lg c(H⁺)。
detail: 常温 pH<7 酸性、=7 中性、>7 碱性；pH 每差 1，氢离子浓度差 10 倍。可用指示剂或 pH 计测定。
detailEn: At 25℃: pH<7 acidic, =7 neutral, >7 basic; each unit is a tenfold change in [H⁺]. Measured by indicators or a pH meter.
